text:
Anya: dropping a compact mock — token pill, single-stop FAB, regen in overflow. thoughts?
Matt: visually 👍. live token update or only after stop?
Anya: live but very low-attention (no flash). users should see growth.
Sophia: accessibility caution: screen readers will read each change. only expose final totals via aria-live.
DesignBot: rec: role=status for final token text, aria-atomic=true when posting final count; keyboard focus for breakdown.
Jess: can we show an "estimated regen cost" beside Regenerate: `~+32`?
Matt: yes but hide by default; opt-in in prompt library settings.
Ryan: stop vs pause: in compact, one primary icon-only Stop, overflow menu with Regenerate + Retry.
Anya: copy sketches: Stop -> "Stop generation — keeps partial reply". Regenerate -> "Regenerate reply" (helper: "Estimated regen cost").
Sophia: ensure token pill meets color contrast 4.5:1 and use an icon, not just color.
Jess: for big-cost regens (>500 tokens) require a confirm modal; small deltas get a toast.
Matt: engineering: batch token UI updates at 20000-300ms to avoid churn. send regen_requested telemetry with before/after estimates.
Ryan: pinned prompts: badge above composer shows pinned prompt preview; changing it updates estimates live. editing opens full prompt editor.
Anya: next: iterate two pill positions (bubble-top vs bubble-corner), deliver copy variants. Jess will post microcopy later.
DesignBot: spec summary: update_interval=250ms, aria-live final-only, breakdown accessible via button with aria-expanded, contrast >=4.5:1.
Matt: I'll spike debounce + a11y props in playground branch.
Jess: posting copy variants this afternoon.
Anya: thanks all — please tag when PRs land :wave:
